title: Essential spectra and eigenvalue asymptotics of Fourier blocks of the elastic Neumann-Poincaré operator on tori
summary: We study the spectral behavior of the Fourier blocks of the elastic Neumann-Poincaré operator on a torus. For the full elastic Neumann-Poincaré operator, it is known that eigenvalues accumulate at three points, namely zero and a symmetric pair of nonzero points determined by the Lamé parameters. It remains unclear whether this spectral structure persists within each individual Fourier block. We prove that, for every fixed Fourier mode, each of these three points is approached by infinitely many discrete eigenvalues from both sides.
